result:
I'd dissolve the gap between what people know intellectually and what they actually *feel* matters.

People understand climate change is real but live as though it isn't urgent. They know loneliness is painful but stay isolated anyway. They recognize their work is meaningless but stay. They see injustice but feel powerless.

If I could change one thing, I'd make the knowing and the feeling align—so when someone truly understands something matters, their bones move toward it. No more comfortable numbness. No more gap between insight and action.

It would be messy and probably hurt. But at least people would finally be honest with themselves about what they actually want, and the world would have to contend with that clarity instead of everyone sleepwalking.
